title: Utility Pass-Through Service Late Fee — Statement Charged and Amount of the Fee
content:
**Clause.** A late fee on a Utility Pass-Through Service statement left unpaid past its grace period is posted in the month after the statement month and is figured on that statement, which is the statement dated one whole month before the handling date when whole months are counted from the statement date to the handling date. The fee is charged only when that statement's unpaid amount at the end of its grace period is at least the schedule's late-fee minimum, it is charged once for that statement, and no late fee is charged on a late fee. The late fee is the schedule's late fee amount, rounded half up to the cent once, on the final figure.

**Unpaid amount at the end of the grace period.** The statement's usage, fixed and administration charges, less its adjustment credits, less the payments received on or before the last grace day as applied to statements oldest first; it is never below zero.

## Which statement (handling date 3 June, hypothetical)

| Statement date | Whole months from the statement date to 3 June | The statement the fee is figured on? |
|---|---|---|
| 1 June | 0 | No |
| 1 May | 1 | Yes |
| 1 April | 2 | No |

## Whether the fee is charged (hypothetical, Submetered Water, Sewer & Natural Gas Schedule: late-fee minimum 10.00, late fee amount 12.00)

| Statement's charges | Adjustment credits | Payments by the last grace day applied to it | Unpaid at the end of grace | Fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 68.40 | 0.00 | 60.00 | 8.40 | none — below 10.00 |
| 68.40 | 0.00 | 58.40 | 10.00 | 12.00 |
| 68.40 | 0.00 | 50.00 | 18.40 | 12.00 |
| 68.40 | 0.00 | 75.00 | 0.00 (never below zero) | none |

## Points of the clause

- **Once per statement.** A statement that already carries a late fee is not charged a second one.
- **No fee on a fee.** A late fee left unpaid does not itself attract a late fee.
- **Rounding.** The fee is rounded half up to the cent once, on the final figure.
